subject: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK + streaming) — draft & owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Blake <samantha.blake@acmemaps.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@acmemaps.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-08T15:12:00Z
Subject: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK + streaming) — draft & owners

Hi Samantha / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on product fit and the initial integration shape. Per our discussion I’ve attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with a focused milestone for the Integration Build Plan.

High-level ask: please review the proposed owners and target dates for the "Integration build plan" milestone and confirm any changes. If you agree, we’ll lock the owners and move to an engineering kickoff and weekly sync cadence.

Proposed Integration build plan (milestones & owners — draft):
- SDK integration (client libraries + auth): Redwood owner: Marissa Cole; Acme owner: Rajiv Singh
- Streaming & low-latency config: Redwood owner: Laura Bennett; Acme owner: Rajiv Singh
- Tool calling / external actions (webhook adapters, retries): Redwood owner: Laura Bennett; Acme owner: Rajiv Singh
- Structured outputs (schema + examples, JSON/Protobuf): Redwood owner: Marissa Cole; Acme owner: Product/PM (Samantha)

Proposed responsibilities / dependencies:
- Acme provides API keys, test account, and representative sample payloads (data contracts) — dependency for SDK and tool-calling work.
- Redwood provides SDK preview packages and streaming test harness.
- Joint QA plan and acceptance criteria document (in MAP).

Target close date (MAP milestone): 2027-01-15 (tentative) — can accelerate if Acme assigns 1 FE + 1 BE to the effort.

Attachments: MAP-draft-20261108.pdf (MAP with milestones), integration-owners-sheet-20261109.xlsx (owners matrix — draft).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm owners and whether the 2027-01-15 milestone looks feasible from your side.
2) If confirmed, we’ll schedule a 30-min eng kickoff next week to capture technical dependencies and initial estimates.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Samantha Blake <samantha.blake@acmemaps.com>

Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@acmemaps.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK + streaming) — draft & owners

Ben —

Thanks for the recap and the MAP draft. Appreciate the clear owners. A few quick notes from our side after syncing with Rajiv:

- Owners: Rajiv will be the Acme engineering lead (confirmed). For product sign-off on structured outputs, I’ll be the PM owner.
- Dates: 2027-01-15 is reasonable but tight given our Q1 priorities. We can commit 1 front-end and 1 backend engineer starting 2026-11-20 if that helps accelerate delivery.
- Streaming questions: can you confirm expected end-to-end latency SLOs for streaming (we discussed sub-300ms for short tokens)? Also want to confirm retry/backpressure behavior for tool-calling flows.

We reviewed the attachment quickly and will circulate internally; Rajiv will add technical comments to the owners sheet by Friday.

If you can send a short engineering kickoff agenda and the streaming test harness instructions, we’ll come prepared.

Best,
Samantha Blake
Head of Product | Acme Maps
samantha.blake@acmemaps.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-10T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK + streaming) — owners & estimates

Ben / Laura —

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the MAP and the owners sheet. Proposed Redwood commitments and rough engineering estimates below (ballpark — will refine after kickoff):

1) SDK integration (client libs + auth) — owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood)
   - Deliverables: language SDKs (JS + Python) example repo, auth flow docs, integration smoke tests.
   - Estimate: 8 engineering days (spread across 2 sprints) + 2 days docs/QA.
   - Risks: auth edge-cases (custom SSO) and sample payload variability.

2) Streaming & low-latency config — owner: Laura Bennett (Redwood)
   - Deliverables: streaming test harness, SLO guidance (latency/backpressure), recommended client-side buffering config.
   - Estimate: 10 engineering days (includes test harness + perf tuning) + 3 days QA.
   - Notes: We can target sub-300ms median for short tokens on our hosted infra; if Acme requires lower p95 we’ll need dedicated tuning.

3) Tool calling / webhook adapters — owner: Laura Bennett (Redwood)
   - Deliverables: sample webhook adapter, retries/exponential backoff example, error handling doc.
   - Estimate: 6 engineering days + 2 days QA.

4) Structured outputs (schema + examples) — owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood)
   - Deliverables: JSON schema templates, mapping guide, example outputs, post-inference validation library.
   - Estimate: 5 engineering days + 1 day docs.

Updated target close date for the Integration build plan milestone: 2027-01-12 (we can accelerate to early Jan if Acme starts engineers 11/20 and provides test accounts immediately).

Action items from Redwood:
- I’ll create the kickoff agenda and a short engineering checklist (auth, sample data, staging access) by EOD 11/10.
- Laura, can you prepare a short section on streaming SLOs and the test harness?

Ben — please confirm whether Acme can provide staging creds and a sample dataset by 11/17. Once confirmed I’ll lock the internal estimates and we’ll schedule the kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
